description: Phase C — Normal continuation: PingPong clip with sectionBehavior=Normal keeps cycling forward / reverse past the break. 16-frame PNG sequence (30fps source, 30fps timeline) extended to 200 timeline frames; section break at timeline frame 8. With Locked, the timeline-derived path would freeze the source frame at 8. With Normal+PingPong, SectionScheduler seeds ClipPlaybackPhase=8 (cycle 0, forward) and advances it each at-break tick -- the phase drifts forward, then reflects back past sourceLength=16. Asserts mediaFrame is NOT 8 by the end of the at-break wait, exercising the reflection branch in the entity-aware mapToMediaFrame.
